verdict.rationale: Durable long-running execution is a fair question for a workflow automation platform, so the axis applies. The pack only documents automatic retries of errored events and a key/value store mention. Nothing shows workflows that pause or wait for days, or that state survives worker or platform restarts. A community report of short per-execution time limits gives no support for long-lived runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run long-lived workflows that wait for days and survive worker or platform restarts without losing state
